problem: Forecast and prediction-quality evidence were visible, but the portal did not show whether the whole Powerhouse self-improvement loop was actually learning.
root_cause: The authenticated portal read model exposed forecast quality only; canonical self-improvement control was not projected into the contextual foresight UI.
fix: Project public.powerhouse_self_improvement_control_v1 through the existing prediction endpoint and render it on Overview and prediction-quality surfaces.
prevention_rule: Autonomous learning is not user-visible until evidence, debt and promotion guardrails are rendered in decision context; code/model change alone is not proof of improvement.
